en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd gathered in a town square in front of low neoclassical buildings and a decorated archway. A tall streetlamp with two curved arms stands in the center foreground. Flags and festive decorations are visible above the crowd. Handwritten notes in Greek appear along the top margin, and a printed website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is visible at the bottom.
